reviewMethod: Read fixed REC source and official history 642a45d0 plus issue1912. Register R2 missing definitions and formal algorithm branches, not implementation-sequence mandates or executed support.

constraints.excerpt: While current is not the root directory:
constraints.reason: Loop termination condition is independent of its two already registered body actions. It controls file-name-to-path construction and cannot be replaced by only the prepend/parent-assignment leaves.

constraints.reason: An empty property string is invalid, independently of the sibling's empty-reference-after-colon prohibition. The apparent EBNF allowance does not override this explicit prose restriction.
constraints.applicability: When processing the EPUB property datatype; list and attribute presence rules are separate.
constraints.phase: T2 metadata/property parsing and validation; T4a explicit metadata maintenance

constraints.reason: In package metadata an alternate link identifies a representation of the package document in its specified media type; it does not mean an alternate content document or collection.
constraints.applicability: Only when alternate appears in package-document metadata.
constraints.phase: T2 metadata association/preservation; T4a authoring; S2-S4 optional link presentation

constraints.reason: In collection metadata an alternate link identifies a representation of that collection in its specified media type. This condition differs from the package metadata case.
constraints.applicability: Only when alternate appears in a collection element's metadata.
constraints.phase: T2 metadata association/preservation; T4a authoring; S2-S4 optional link presentation

constraints.reason: Reading systems need not generate hyperlinks for alternate links. Register the permission boundary; do not invert it into a MUST to generate hyperlinks or infer absence of support is nonconforming.
constraints.applicability: Reading-system handling of alternate links; preserved link data and optional UI behavior are distinct.
constraints.phase: T2 link preservation; S2-S4 optional metadata-link presentation

constraints.reason: The nav child ol represents the primary navigation level; content-model cardinality alone does not record this semantic role.
constraints.applicability: An epub:type-carrying nav in the EPUB navigation document, under the section's content-model scope.
constraints.phase: T2 navigation model; T3 conversion; T4a maintenance; S4 accessibility

constraints.reason: A list item represents a heading/structure/item of interest; child a describes the linked target, while span groups headings. The parenthetic illustration is not an independent required grouping feature.
constraints.applicability: Primary navigation list semantics; preserve a/span distinction rather than treating any label as an editable link target.
constraints.phase: T2 navigation model; T3 conversion; T4a maintenance; S4 accessibility
